identity.title: Volcanion and the Mechanical Magearna Music Collection

leadText:
----
 
Pokémon the Movie XY&Z: Volcanion and the Mechanical Magearna Music Collection (Japanese: ポケモン・ザ・ムービーXY＆Z「ボルケニオンと機巧のマギアナ」ミュージックコレクション) is the Japanese soundtrack for the nineteenth movie. It was released in Japan on July 27, 2016.
